dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the mid-dorsal flank exhibit high-contrast, dark-pixel perimeters approximately 5-15 pixels wide, transitioning sharply to lighter interior centers; one particularly distinct closed 'O' is located mid-body with a secondary open 'C' structure positioned posterior-dorsally.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of small, dark, irregular pixel clusters in the anterior-neck region; spatial density decreases towards the posterior, where blobs become larger, more isolated, and show less internal gradient, forming a high-contrast boundary along the lower lateral line.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary geometric relationship is formed by the centroids of three major macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal region, creating an asymmetrical triangle; this is complemented by a near-linear series of four high-intensity blobs along the ventral-lateral transition.
